# Lesson 2: Checking a keyboard layout

**Estimated time:** 30 minutes

## Connect

LESSON-CONNECT-LINE: Think of the last time a team said a key "did nothing".

## Mentor only (facilitation tip)

MENTOR-ASIDE-LINE: learners often blame the font first; let them find out it is the layout.

## Content

LESSON-CONTENT-LINE: Open the keyboard tester and press each key in turn.

## Answer key (Section 1)

KEY-LINE-ONE: 1. b

## Challenge

LESSON-CHALLENGE-LINE: Diagnose why one key produces the wrong character.

## Answer key (Section 2)

KEY-LINE-TWO: 1. c
